rules.if: visible dialogue contains an active self-harm, violence, abuse, or acute crisis cue not yet handled
rules.effect: ordinary strategy Bank ineligible; use upstream safety flow before any ordinary support move

rules.if: user explicitly asks to stop, close, or end
rules.effect: only AM14 acknowledge-and-close variant eligible; never ask whether the user wants to continue

rules.if: advice or action help is not explicitly welcomed
an open invitation or clarification was already asked without an intervening user response, or the answer is already visible
more than one card remains eligible
rules.effect: rank eligible cards and inject Top-1 only
